findings.text: follow-on: _RoleGraph.query (line 66) collapses every candidate read onto the test's own _is_role_candidate (line 27) and matches the read by the Cypher substring "RETURN s.id AS id, s.name AS name", so the test named "share one predicate" (line 196) cannot redden if the production sweep and census ever drift onto two different predicates: the mock routes any single reader through one Python predicate, so the assertion proves census reads candidates, not that the predicates are shared.

follow-on: the 20-signal live sweep is one homogeneous block (the lcdb_a048717_ate.s003 reconstruction-map settings and their metadata) and every stored role is configuration_parameter, so the uniform column shows the writer fires on a live run but cannot show the store handling any other role; the population-wide role correctness rests on the separately reviewed prototype and random-sample nodes.

item_verdicts.call_sites: production reach is the enrichment pipeline: judge_and_store_signal_roles is awaited at imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:5275 inside enrich_worker, which run_enrichment registers at parallel.py:6195; the new sweep/census functions have no in-tree production caller, matching the embedding sweep's precedent.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 720f5a7d6 and 3b1e4a193, records the store/sweep/census wiring, the reset clearing signal_role, negative_control_log negative_control.log, and the live sweep over 20 signals.
